# Nick Korom
> Professional profile of Nick Korom, short-term rental investor, operator, and educator.

## About
Nick Korom is a short-term rental investor and operator who helps aspiring STR hosts build profitable Airbnb and vacation rental businesses. He is the founder of BnB Accelerator, a program that teaches investors how to find, furnish, and manage short-term rental properties for maximum returns.
